newsitem.title: UK: Northn Electric to sell combined power stakes.
newsitem.headline: Northn Electric to sell combined power stakes.

text.p: British regional electricity company Northern Electric Plc said on Friday it had decided to sell its one third interest in a combined heat and power (chp) services company called Combined Power Systems Limited (CPSL).
In a statement it said that discussions with a prospective industrial buyer were underway "and are expected to be concluded within a month".
Northern is currently one of three shareholders in CPSL, and its CPS (Northern) unit, which owns and manages operational chp units.
After a hard-fought takeover bid that it finally lost on December 24, Northern Electric is currently being acquired completely by CE Electric, part of U.S group CalEnergy.
